bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 16" x 16" are allowed and must pass X-ray. Clutches up to 6" x 4" x 1.5" skip X-ray. Clear bags are not required.
allowed: Approved medical and childcare bags (X-ray screened)
bagPolicy.note: The arena encourages guests not to bring bags, since a bag can add 30 minutes or more to entry. There is no bag or coat check, and prohibited bags cannot be stored on site.

parking.note: Parking is available at the garage attached to Enterprise Center and other nearby facilities. Visitors can access parking from various streets including Clark Avenue and 18th Street. The City Traffic Department advises against using the 14th Street exit from I-64/U.S. 40 for better traffic flow.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Enterprise Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Enterprise Center has concession stands and portable carts across the Plaza and Mezzanine levels with stadium staples, local/specialty foods, soft drinks, beer, wine, and mixed drinks. Offerings and locations can vary by event.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: To purchase accessible tickets for an upcoming event, please call our Box Office ADA Hotline at 314-622-5420 or click here. Spaces featuring accessibility for oversized vans are available on the first level of the garage.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: If guests need to leave and re-enter, we ask that they scan their ticket out at the smoking exit near Portal 8.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Please check out our box office section on our Tickets Option page for current operating hours for the Enterprise Center Box Office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The designated smoking area will be available from the time doors open until approximately 30 minutes before the estimated end of the event. Doors open 90 minutes prior to most events.

glance.value: Bags up to 16" x 16" are allowed and must pass X-ray
